description: Transport for London: transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in London Datastore, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Transport for London. Coverage: Transport for London. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Number of Bicycle Hires; Cycle Flows on the TFL Road Network; Key Performance Indicators on the TFL Road Network. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence v2. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-london-datastore.
